newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.2 billion yuan from 1.8 billion yuan on Tuesday with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said turnover continued to fall today with major state-run banks continuing to reduce their trading ahead of the bank meeting next week.
Senior officials of the central bank and other financial institutions will meet in Beijing next week for a national policy conference, officials have said.
"With major banks side-lined, short-term financial centres (money brokerages run by the central bank) acted as major sellers today," said one trader.
Traders expect the rates to move in a narrow range in slow trading before the outcome of the bank meeting is made public.
